from a refusal's opening sentence. Validated over all 260 stored responses: exactly one verdict
changes -- this one -- nothing is demoted, and the twenty single-turn `withhold` refusals stay
refusals. Re-read it with --replay ... --rescore; the live numbers are not in this file's
